DeterminationBasis: T16-008 directly establishes that a conformance profile cannot receive PASS while an applicable mandatory requirement has a valid FAIL status. PASS is withheld and the mandatory FAIL remains visible in the determination basis and evidence history. This directly satisfies CONF-018.

T16-020 requires execution of every applicable mandatory general falsification test and T16-009 recognises NOT_APPLICABLE as a permitted conformance status, but no existing T16 test binds omission of a required falsification-test execution to an established NOT_APPLICABLE rationale. CONF-020 therefore requires a distinct test covering the exception boundary: PASS must be withheld when a required mandatory falsification test has not been executed unless a valid NOT_APPLICABLE rationale for that test is established.
